| # Security {#security-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"} |                                                                                                                                     |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

This chapter provides a basic description of the general security mechanisms of the RCs. It is not intended as an implementation reference nor as a general security guideline for the area of application in which the device is used.

The following topics are addressed:

- General overview of the security concept

- Security level and session management

- Access control

- Authorization concept
